one_line: Assembles the support inequality on the whole unswapped IIIb-plus region of T_65 (b > 1, a < 1/b, p, c > 0, 0 < j <= e, j > eb/(e+b)). The new cross-range and stationary-range certificates were replayed EXACT, with stationary counts matching. Correct modulo the cited high-j theorem, the negative-Phi theorem and foundation atoms.
